1.text: Nuko muri icyo gihe Umwami Herode afatira abo mu Itorero bamwe kubagirira nabi.

2.text: Yicisha Yakobo inkota, mwene se wa Yohana.

3.text: Abonye ko anejeje Abayuda, ariyongeza afata na Petero. Icyo gihe hari mu minsi y'imitsima idasembuwe.

4.text: Amaze kumufata amushyira mu nzu y'imbohe, amuha abasirikare cumi na batandatu kumurinda bane bane, agira ngo azamushyīre abantu Pasika ishize.

5.text: Nuko Petero arindirwa mu nzu y'imbohe, ariko ab'Itorero bagira umwete wo kumusabira ku Mana.

6.text: Herode araye ari bumusohore, iryo joro Petero yari asinziriye hagati y'abasirikare babiri, aboheshejwe iminyururu ibiri, abarinzi na bo bari ku rugi barinda inzu y'imbohe.

7.text: Nuko marayika w'Umwami Imana ahagarara aho, umucyo waka mu nzu, marayika akoma Petero mu mbavu aramukangura ati “Byuka n'ingoga.” Iminyururu imuva ku maboko iragwa.

8.text: Marayika aramubwira ati “Kenyera ukwete inkweto zawe.” Abigenza atyo. Arongera aramubwira ati “Wifubike umwitero wawe, unkurikire.”

9.text: Arasohoka aramukurikira, ariko ntiyamenya ibyo marayika akoze ko ari iby'ukuri, ahubwo agira ngo abirose mu nzozi.

10.text: Banyuze ku barinzi ba mbere no ku ba kabiri, bagera ku irembo rikingishijwe urugi rw'icyuma rijya mu murwa. Rurabīkingurira ubwarwo barasohoka banyura inzira imwe, uwo mwanya marayika amusiga aho.

11.text: Petero agaruye umutima aribwira ati “Noneho menye by'ukuri yuko Umwami Imana yatumye marayika wayo, ikankura mu maboko ya Herode, ikankiza ibyo ubwoko bw'Abayuda bwategerezaga byose.”

12.text: Akibitekereza atyo, asohora kwa Mariya nyina wa Yohana wahimbwe Mariko, aho abantu benshi bari bateraniye basenga.

13.text: Petero akomanga ku rugi rw'irembo, umuja witwaga Rode ajya kubyumva.

14.text: Amenya ijwi rya Petero, ibinezaneza bimubuza gukingura, nuko yirukanka asubira mu nzu ababwira yuko Petero ahagaze ku irembo.

15.text: Baramusubiza bati “Urasaze!” Ariko akomeza guhamya ko ari koko. Bati “Ahubwo ni marayika we.”

16.text: Ariko Petero akomeza gukomanga, bakinguye basanga ari we koko barumirwa.

17.text: Arabamama, abasobanurira uko Umwami Imana yamukuye mu nzu y'imbohe, arababwira ati “Mubitekerereze Yakobo na bene Data bandi.” Arasohoka ajya ahandi.

18.text: Bukeye abasirikare bashiguka imitima cyane, bananirwa kumenya uko Petero yabaye.

19.text: Herode na we amushatse aramubura abaza abo barinzi, ategeka ko babīca. Ava i Yudaya ajya i Kayisariya, aba ari ho aba.

20.text: Bukeye Herode arakarira ab'i Tiro n'i Sidoni, ariko bahuza inama baramusanga, bahongera Bulasito umutware w'abashashi b'umwami, basaba amahoro kuko igihugu cyabo cyahahaga mu cy'Umwami Herode.

21.text: Nuko ku munsi wategetswe Herode yambara imyenda y'ubugabe, yicara ku ntebe y'ubwami arabaganirira.

22.text: Abantu barasakuza bati “Yemwe noneho ni ijwi ry'Imana, si iry'umuntu!”

23.text: Ariko muri ako kanya marayika w'Umwami Imana aramukumbanya kuko adahaye Imana icyubahiro, aherako agwa inyo umwuka urahera.

25.text: Kandi Barinaba na Sawuli bamaze kubashyikiriza za mfashanyo bahawe, bava i Yerusalemu basubirayo, bajyana Yohana wahimbwe Mariko.
